kind: Controlled EditMode real TrackSelectionUI.Initialize/Show, original track buttons and Hide. No MainMenuUI.Start, gameplay manager, launch or authored scene changes.
lifecycle: Isolated preview Canvas/camera; original localized font and material cloned static before production UI creation. Callback only records ID. Session selectedTrackId restored exactly in finally. Hover/pressed use native Selectable.DoStateTransition with instant=true because synchronous EditMode has no tween player loop; disabled also sets real interactable=false. No click is synthesized for these states. Closed image intentionally shows empty preview host, not a fabricated main menu. Geometry counts only activeInHierarchy labels/cards. No fake ninth track.
